## The two big site-wide arguments (they decide almost every Kun thread)
1. **The "Malak quote".** WotC Star Wars Miniatures web article "Darth Malak: An Expanded Universe Character": Malak's mask/cybernetics - "Did it provide him with powers far greater than even Exar Kun or Freedon Nadd?" (my vitiate-comicvine-respect-part1.txt has it phrased as a question; the article then suggests cybernetics is "too simple an explanation" and points to the Star Forge, per DarthAnt66). Pro-Malak side (DarthAnt66, darthbane77, IG, MP, EmperorCaedus): Star Forge Malak > Kun, so Revan > Malak > Kun and anyone above Revan beats Kun. Anti side (AncientPower/LadyKulvax, XSUPREMEXSKILLZ, BreakofDawn by 2021): the article's author later told AncientPower the "powers" meant Star Forge/galactic power (author clarification on Twitter, disputed as a "loaded question" by a Guest); it's a miniatures-game piece; the later KOTOR Campaign Guide Malak sheet makes no such claim; and it doesn't bind Spirit Kun. Also cited against it: Kreia/Mandalorian on Nadd's tomb (KOTOR II, Dxun/Onderon, cut-content companion dialogue): Nadd "far worse than Revan and Malak ever were"; Kreia: "Freedon Nadd's power seems to have been underestimated". Counter (DarthAnt66, S_W_LeGenD): "worse" = more evil/tyrant, and it's cut content.
2. **Spirit Kun vs living Kun.** Pro-strong-spirit posters (IG, Jake, AncientPower) use the Dark Apprentice Luke beatdown and Specter of the Past "two of the greatest focal points" line to put Kun near Sidious. PeraltaEagle45: spirit Kun "was able to dominate Luke due to Luke not having prepared". t551: AncientPower cites the Jedi Academy Sourcebook (spirit lacks the energy to use his powers / take human form) and claims Tom Veitch (writer) confirmed living Kun was stronger; KingofBlades argued the Massassi ritual empowered him. Ziggy: "Kun was definitely more powerful alive than as a spirit. Less powerful than the combination of Kyp + Yavin Temples + Spirit Kun against an obviously jobbing Luke."

## Main arguments by thread
### t22 Dooku vs Exar Kun
- Pro-Kun (AncientPower, XSUPREMEXSKILLZ): chain "Exar Kun >>> Spirit Kun > Kyp + Luke >> Dooku"; Krayt-growth chain via Hett/Obi-Wan (rejected by others as unquantifiable); Dark Reaper / Force Harvester (Star Wars: The Clone Wars 2002 game) as Kun's creation. "Kun's feats utterly dump on Dooku's."
- Pro-Dooku (DC77, ArkhamAsylum3/Guest, PeraltaEagle45, TrevaDaProgSnob): AP's chains have "no evidence"; Luke as a spirit couldn't fight back and had no knowledge of the technique (TrevaDaProgSnob, quoting Champions of the Force: "And I have had endless millennia to practice"); film > novel under the 2012 canon policy, and the ROTS film/JN show Dooku "effortlessly/easily" holding off Obi-Wan + Anakin. Ziggy: "The handling of Kenobi with Anakin is better combatively than anything we've seen from Kun", but the Senate spell while fighting Baas is "better in terms of magnitude"; "Dooku could win in single combat for sure."
- Votes (rough): Dooku ~9 (darthbane77, Azronger, PeraltaEagle45, trayvon, DC77, two Guests, dark-sith123 "rather decisively", Fallen Warrior). Kun ~2-3 (AncientPower, XSUPREMEXSKILLZ; Ziggy split). Forum opinion: Dooku.
- **Grok's take:** disagree with the majority. Kun's on-page record (Ulic parity for "hours", kills weapon-master Baas, Odan-Urr's power can't stop him, Senate-wide spell, Nadd's spirit) and the "far more powerful than any one other Jedi of the time" line beat Dooku's (Dooku's best is near-Yoda statements and losing to Yoda on Vjun). The pro-Dooku side mostly attacked AP's chains instead of Kun's own feats. But AP's chains are bad (Krayt-growth via Hett), and the spirit feat on Luke is 2-on-1 with Luke on pure defense, so I wouldn't call it a stomp.

### t3417 Revan vs Exar Kun (SoR Revan and Revan Reborn vs prime Kun)
- Pro-Revan (DarthAnt66, S_W_LeGenD, Guest, Lord Eon, SithSauce, lord of hunger, early BreakofDawn): Malak quote; Revan's "way better feats"; Star Forge drain quote (Databank: Malak "nearly unstoppable"; KOTOR: "You cannot beat me, Revan. Not here on the Star Forge") and Revan still beat that Malak.
- Pro-Kun (AncientPower, Primarch, 2021 BreakofDawn): "Kun is a vastly better duelist and has proven feats against better characters than Revan has faced"; the Nadd-tomb lines; author clarification on the Malak quote. BreakofDawn 2021: "R1: Could go either way but leaning Revan. R2: Leaning Kun due to sorcery. R3: Leaning Kun."
- Indecentmortal: Avellone said KOTOR II deliberately hyped the ancient Sith for a planned KOTOR III, so discount it.
- Votes: Revan ~7, Kun ~3. Forum opinion: Revan.
- **Grok's take:** close; slight Revan lean overall, Kun in the Force round. Revan beat Star-Forge-amped Malak and is a tier-5 fixture in my list, and the Malak quote (even if it's a question in a miniatures article) points the same way. I don't use the Nadd-tomb line: cut content, and "worse" can mean "more evil." Kun's sorcery and saberstaff tricks are a real edge, and nobody in the thread proved Revan handles Senate-scale mind domination. See verdict file.

### t29 Vader (ROTJ) vs Exar Kun (Sith War #6)
- Pro-Kun (AncientPower, XSUPREMEXSKILLZ, Ziggy "fairly lopsided", darthbane77 "*should* win", DarthSkywalker0 "very close", slayne): spirit Kun + Kyp beat Luke; Kyp hyped as "another Darth Vader. Perhaps even worse"; Leia's Kueller line (New Rebellion) puts spirit Kun above Kueller; Vader's suit limits mobility. AncientPower's anti-Malak-quote case: KOTOR CG Malak sheet makes no claim; the same miniatures article says Draay "won't outfight Lord Vader or Darth Bane" and Bastila "roughly on par with Obi-Wan Kenobi" (game-mechanics comparisons, per AP; darthbane77/Guest reply those are explicitly "in the Star Wars miniatures game" sections while the Malak line is in the lore summary).
- Pro-Vader (PeraltaEagle45 "good fight", Azronger, Fallen Warrior): Kun overrated; Malak's 300% Star Forge control > living Kun's feats.
- Votes: Kun ~7, Vader ~3. Forum opinion: Kun.
- **Grok's take:** agree, Kun, but not "one-shots". Living Kun has the sorcery, the Baas/Ulic dueling record and the stamina Vader lacks; Vader's ROTJ performance against Luke is beatable. The Kyp-"another Vader" line is potential hype for Kyp, not a Vader comparison, so I don't use it. Medium confidence.

### t820 / t1853 Maul vs Exar Kun
- t820 split by round: sabers mostly Maul (PeraltaEagle45, HellfireUnit, Deronn_Solo, dark_globe, DC77, Guest, KingofBlades); Force and all-out mostly Kun. AncientPower: "Maul is Ulic tier, not Exar Kun tier." MP: if the Malak quote is used, Maul wins all rounds (DC77: no link between Malak and Maul).
- t1853 (TPM Maul vs amulet Kun): Kun 3 (HellfireUnit "Force abilities", BreakofDawn "decent fight", MP), Maul 1 (DC77 "barring potential use of esoteric abilities").
- **Grok's take:** agree with the round split. Maul probably edges a pure saber fight (athleticism, Kun = Ulic and Maul has no Ulic link, so this is a low-confidence call), but Kun wins all-out with Force/sorcery. No poster cited a single quote here; it's all vibes. Low-medium confidence.

### t723 Krayt vs Exar Kun
- Pro-Krayt (HellfireUnit "smashes", The Lost, PeraltaEagle45 "Prime Krayt annihilates... like pitting Maul against prime Sidious", MasterCilghal/IG/Guest split Vong vs Reborn): Krayt is a tier above. Jake: the Corsair lift was done "on an enormous nexus focused by Temples".
- Pro-Kun: AncientPower only ("Krayt, Wyyrlok and Cade are Jedi Exiles tier at best" - fringe).
- Forum opinion: Reborn Krayt clearly; Vong Krayt split.
- **Grok's take:** agree, Reborn Krayt. Krayt's Abeloth showing with Luke (FotJ: Apocalypse) and reborn dark-transfer outrank anything living Kun shows. Kun vs armored Krayt (ill, Legacy) is closer.

### t1660 Exar Kun vs Caedus
- Pro-Caedus (DC77, IG, EmperorCaedus, Tondemonai ~8/10, BreakofDawn "handily", Ellimist "by overall scaling"). Ellimist: "Exar Kun generally has better environmental feats than Caedus". Jake: "A truly peak (physical JA) Kun would definitely win"; cites Leia's Kueller line, Specter of the Past, and the German Dark Apprentice blurb ("the most powerful Dark Lord of the Sith" - a publisher blurb, near zero weight). [panel: panels/exar-kun/exar-kun-yeah-german-blurb-dark-apprentice-kun-powerful-1.png]
- Pro-Kun: AncientPower.
- Forum opinion: Caedus.
- **Grok's take:** lean Caedus (low-medium). Caedus's Fondor shield drop by mass mind-influence is a better Force-scale feat than the Senate spell, and he has the deeper fighting toolkit (shatterpoint, Aing-Tii fighting-sight, flow-walking). Kun has the sorcery wildcard. Not a formal verdict in the draft (not requested).

### t659 Mace Windu (Palpatine-amped) vs Exar Kun
- Mostly Mace (BreakofDawn "prime Mace wins", Guest, Praxis, Blade_of_Dorin, HellfireUnit); Kun: Jake ("melts his face with sorcery"), AncientPower. No evidence posted.
- **Grok's take:** no opinion yet; the thread has no evidence and it's an amped Mace. Mace (tier 5) vs Kun is a real open question for the next pass.

### t551 Spirit Kun vs Physical Kun
- Covered above. **Grok's take:** agree living Kun > spirit Kun. The Jedi Academy Sourcebook says it outright (spirit can't harness most of his powers without others' energy) and Jedi vs. Sith says the Luke/Kyp effort "tired Exar Kun out". The Veitch author confirmation is AP's report only (unverified, GAP).

## What Grok takes from SI overall
- The site is split almost entirely by two filters (the Malak quote and spirit-vs-living Kun), not by Kun's own feats. Kun-friendly posters lean on AncientPower's chains, which are mostly multi-link; Kun-skeptics lean on the Malak quote, which is a question in a miniatures-game web article.
- Consensus-ish (opinion): Dooku > Kun at SI (I disagree), Revan > Kun (I lean agree, close), Kun > ROTJ Vader (agree), Kun > Maul all-out but Maul in sabers (agree), Reborn Krayt > Kun (agree), Caedus > Kun (lean agree).
- GAPS: the older Mace vs Kun thread, t1513/t581 team threads, t2436 Plagueis, t555 Bane, t2818 Vitiate not read. Author-clarification claims (Malak article author; Tom Veitch) are second-hand and unverified.
